sentences.text:
Order 
This is first application filed under Section 483 of Bhartiya Nargik Surkasha Sanhita, 2023 on behalf of applicant, who is in jail since 14.7.2024 in connection with Crime No. 554/2024, registered at Police Station Kotwali District Damoh for the offence punishable under Sections 366, 376(2)(N) of the Indian Penal Code.
2. Learned counsel appearing for the applicant submitted that applicant is young man of 19 years of age.
He was in love relationship with prosecutrix.
In these circumstances, applicant may be enlarged on bail.

3. Govt. Advocate for the State has opposed the bail application and submitted that offence is serious in nature.
4.
Heard learned counsel for the parties.
5. Considering the totality of the facts and circumstances of the case, bail application filed by the applicant is allowed.
